description: This file implements functions related to managing 'resolve undo' information within a version control system, likely Git. It handles reading, writing, recording, clearing, and applying resolve undo data in the index, facilitating undoing or resolving merge conflicts or other index modifications.

methods.name: void record_resolve_undo(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Records resolve undo information for a specific cache entry in the index's resolve undo list.

methods.name: void resolve_undo_write(struct strbuf * sb,struct string_list * resolve_undo,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Serializes the resolve undo information into a string buffer for storage or transmission.

methods.name: struct:string_list * resolve_undo_read(const char * data,unsigned long size,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses resolve undo data from raw data buffer to reconstruct the list of undo information.

methods.name: void resolve_undo_clear_index(struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Clears and frees the resolve undo list associated with the index.

methods.name: void unmerge_index(struct index_state * istate,const struct pathspec * pathspec,unsigned ce_flags)
methods.description: Reverts a subset of index entries based on resolve undo info and pathspec, effectively unmerging conflicts.

methods.name: int unmerge_index_entry(struct index_state * istate,const char * path,struct resolve_undo_info * ru,unsigned ce_flags)
